final: WITH per_state AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.State), ''), '<none>') AS state, SUM(i.Total) AS total, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS n FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY state) SELECT SUM(total) AS sum_of_state_totals, AVG(n) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM per_state
